read_before_measuring.r0_1: NEMO's tracer sweep, compiled ppsrc cfgs/GYRE_OMIP_L2_P3_SM_R35TRAZDF/BLD/ppsrc/nemo/trazdf.f90. 1st recurrence :493 zwt(ji,1)=zwd(ji,1) and :496 zwt(ji,jk)=zwd(ji,jk)-zwi(ji,jk)*zws(ji,jk-1)/zwt(ji,jk-1) -- multiply THEN divide THEN subtract. 2nd recurrence :515-516 (surface, written straight into pt(Kaa)), :528-529 (zrhs) and :532 pt(jk,Kaa)=zrhs-zwi(ji,jk)/zwt(ji,jk-1)*pt(jk-1,Kaa) -- divide THEN multiply THEN subtract. 3rd recurrence :543 pt(jpkm1)=pt(jpkm1)/zwt(jpkm1)*tmask and :546-547 pt(jk)=(pt(jk)-zws(ji,jk)*pt(jk+1))/zwt(ji,jk)*tmask -- multiply, subtract, divide, mask, at EVERY level.
read_before_measuring.r0_2: The dry diagonal: :445 zwd(ji,jk)=(e3t_3d*(1+r3t(Kaa)*tmask))-(zwi+zws) is written UNCONDITIONALLY, wet or dry. legoESM's nemo_tracer_tridiagonal ends with jnp.where(wet>0, diagonal, 1.0).
read_before_measuring.r0_3: The RHS NEMO builds, :515-516 and :528-529: e3t(Kbb)*T(Kbb) + p2dt*e3t(Kmm)*T(Krhs). THREE time levels of thickness are involved: Kbb on the tracer term, Kmm on the tendency term, Kaa on the diagonal (:445).
read_before_measuring.r0_4: legoESM's NEMO cards resolve tracer_combine='concentration' (round 36, Rule 10, printed by the gate), so _nemo_tracer_content_rhs is None and the literal matrix is fed T_solve_in*dz_cell = e3t(Kaa)*(T(Kbb)+p2dt*T(Krhs)). That is a DIFFERENT EXPRESSION from NEMO's, not a different association: NEMO never multiplies the Kbb tracer by the Kaa thickness.
read_before_measuring.r0_5: The barotropic correction, compiled ppsrc stprk3_stg.f90:522-523: zub = uu_b(Kaa) - SUM( e3u_3d(ji,jj,:)*uu(ji,jj,:,Kaa) ) * r1_hu_0(ji,jj). Fortran's SUM over a rank-1 section has no specified order, but gfortran emits the ascending-k loop; legoESM uses jnp.sum, whose XLA reduction is a tree.
read_before_measuring.r0_6: Round 36 measured, given NEMO's inputs: calibration 0/21120 on all 13 rows; assembly.zwd 3120/21120 = exactly the dry cells; assembly.zwi/zws 704 signed zeros each; sweep.T 133 and sweep.S 111 WET cells at 7.105e-15; rhs_content 0/21120 both tracers.

already_measured_before_this_preregistra.note: Localisation of the sweep residual was run before this file was written and is recorded here rather than presented as a prediction.
already_measured_before_this_preregistra.m1: A plain NumPy sequential transcription of :493/:496, :515-516/:528-529/:532 and :543/:546-547 reproduces NEMO's dumped zwt_lu, fwd_T/fwd_S and sol_T/sol_S at 0 cells unequal on all 21120 scored cells. So NEMO's statements, separately rounded, ARE legoESM's claimed association.
already_measured_before_this_preregistra.m2: The same transcription with a FUSED multiply-add in the 2nd AND 3rd recurrences (math.fma) reproduces legoESM's JAX solve at 0 cells unequal on all 21120 cells, both tracers; with the fusion in only one of the two it does not (63 and 80 cells left over on T). The 1st recurrence ends in a division and cannot be contracted, which is why the LU row was never over the bar.
already_measured_before_this_preregistra.m3: On 4096 random triples, XLA:CPU evaluates c-a*b as a fused multiply-add in every form tried -- plain, jax.lax.optimization_barrier on the product, on a tuple, lax.reduce_precision, and a bitcast round trip (812 of 4096 cells differ from the separately-rounded result, 0 from the fused one). Giving the product a SECOND USE reproduces the separately-rounded result exactly (0 of 4096). XLA_FLAGS --xla_allow_excess_precision=false and --xla_cpu_enable_fast_math=false do not change the tra_zdf sweep rows.

PR1.claim: The owner of sweep.T/sweep.S is XLA's fused multiply-add, not a transcription error, and not the dry diagonal or the tmask placement -- every one of the 133/111 differing cells sits in a column with ZERO dry cells.
PR1.falsifier: any differing cell in a column that has a dry cell, or fma-BOTH not reproducing legoESM exactly

PR2.claim: Giving the multiply a second use inside the two contracted recurrences drives GYRE's sweep.T and sweep.S to 0/21120 with max abs 0.0.

PR3.claim: THE UPSTREAM OWNER OF THE kt=1 STAGE-3 RESIDUAL IS THE RIGHT-HAND SIDE FORM, not any operator upstream of tra_zdf and not the solve. Built from NEMO's OWN dumped operands, legoESM's concentration-form RHS e3t(Kaa)*(T(Kbb)+rDt*T(Krhs)) fed through NEMO's own dumped matrix will reproduce the trajectory's stage-3 residual to within a factor of a few: order 1e-11 K on T and 1e-12 psu on S, against the trajectory's 3.1956659540810506e-11 K and 8.1712414612411521e-13 psu.
PR3.falsifier: that residual is below 1e-13 K, three orders under the trajectory's, which would exonerate the RHS form and put the owner back upstream of tra_zdf

PR4.claim: Dropping the dry-diagonal replacement makes assembly.zwd 0/21120 and moves NO wet cell.
PR4.falsifier: a wet cell moves, or the row does not reach 0

PR5.claim: Accumulating the barotropic correction's column sum in NEMO's ascending-k order discharges OVERFLOW's rule12_correction.u to 0/16900 exact, and leaves GYRE and LOCK bit-identical.
PR5.falsifier: OVERFLOW does not reach exact, or GYRE/LOCK move

PR6.claim: Decision 20 executes ONLY if assembly.zwi, assembly.zwd, assembly.zws and both sweep rows are all 0 cells unequal, signed zeros INCLUDED. Anything short of that leaves tracer_combine at concentration and reports the blocking statement.
PR6.falsifier: n/a -- this is the round's own gate on itself

rule12_discharge_plan.the shared sweep: _nemo_ordered_solve is called by BOTH the tracer pair solve and the momentum solve, so a change to it touches every card. GYRE: the round-35 tracer record (sweep arm) and the round-29/35 momentum record. LOCK_EXCHANGE and OVERFLOW: their round-33 dyn_zdf records carry zwi_u/zwd_u/zws_u, uu_Kaa_pre and uu_Kaa_out, so the same arm can be driven there without a new acquisition. NO card that executes the change is left UNMEASURED.
rule12_discharge_plan.the dry diagonal: nemo_tracer_tridiagonal is reached only through the tracer pair solve. GYRE is measured by the round-35 record. The tanks have NO tracer-matrix record; the frame spec for one is a trazdf instrument on each tank card writing zwi/zwd/zws/rhs/sol at kt=nit000, exactly as round 35 did for GYRE. Until then their discharge is by TRAJECTORY: kt=1..10 before/after, and the rows that move are registered.
